value.rationale: Stable P2 semi-Lagrangian advection can preserve a modified, Courant-dependent positive mean rather than its natural Simpson reconstructed mass. The classification identifies exactly two single-step mass-consistent Courants, the sharp 1/3 worst-case long-time mass discrepancy at vanishing fractional shift, and a complete polynomial law allowing two individually nonconservative steps to cancel their mass defects. These provide natural diagnostic and paired-step design criteria; checkerboard extremizers and smooth-data limits are explicitly distinguished.
